days.text: let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits;

“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh. For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green; and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him. He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
